row.evidence: Infor OS Security's SCIM Accounts page "shows the URLs for the System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) service and SCIM user identifiers" so a third-party SCIM application can "load users to Infor OS Portal automatically"; Infor publishes no prices (sales contact only).
row.notes: Quote-only: Infor publishes no price list (infor.com/pricing is 404; the contact page routes buyers to sales), so SCIM is gated per rule 6a. Researched Infor OS (the identity/security layer under every Infor CloudSuite: Infor OS Portal, Security, Infor Federation Services), not the individual ERP/HCM/SCM apps. SCIM 2.0 is enabled per tenant (Manage Features > Enable SCIM Service); admins create SCIM user identifiers and passwords in Security > Manage > SCIM Accounts, and the bearer token is base64(identifier:password). SCIM groups map automatically to security roles, functional roles, accounting entities, locations and groups. Okta OIN 'Infor CloudSuite' app supports SAML and SCIM (Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking; checked items read from page markup); the Entra gallery app provisions users and groups (Microsoft Learn tutorial), including Infor extension attributes. Users can also be imported by CSV/XML.

plans.name: Infor CloudSuite (Infor OS)
plans.notes: No public price list; Infor OS (portal, security, IFS) is the platform under every CloudSuite.

auth.token_source: Infor OS Portal > Security > Manage > SCIM Accounts > Add new item (SCIM password; User Identifier generated); token = base64(User Identifier:SCIM Password)

deprovision.notes: Entra 'disables' users in Infor CloudSuite; disabled users can be re-activated in Security. Infor's SCIM protocol page says deprovisioning 'removes access when users leave'.

custom.how: Infor extension schema urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:infor:2.0:User with actorId, federationId, ifsPersonId, lnUser, userAlias

roles.how: SCIM groups map to security roles, functional security roles, accounting entities, LN user data defaults sets, groups and locations; members get them automatically.

limitations.text: Entra users with the Default Access role are excluded from provisioning.
Deleting a SCIM user identifier breaks any SCIM application configured with it.

scim.notes: Base URL is shown per tenant on the SCIM Accounts page (Microsoft's tutorial shows an Infor dev example host ending /v2/scim); not recorded as a pattern. Attribute list and filtering come from Microsoft's Entra tutorial, not Infor's docs.

user_api.notes: Infor OS Security APIs (REST via the ION API gateway; bearer tokens, OAuth2 scopes, service accounts, client credentials) are used to create and manage users, roles and service accounts. Endpoint paths are not in the public admin guide (API catalogue sits inside the tenant).

okta.notes: OIN checked items: SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Gallery app 'Infor CloudSuite'; provisioning tutorial on Microsoft Learn.

fallbacks.other_sync: Okta Active Mode (credential validation against Okta for e-signatures, by support ticket); service users and ION-based security sync.
fallbacks.notes: Users can be imported and updated by CSV or XML (XML needed for roles). SAML 2.0 federated security is configured in Infor OS.
